policy.rule: Technical maturity never implies permission. REUSE or ADAPT requires exact-source authorship/license evidence and competition-policy clearance.
policy.result: No exact application-source file cleared both requirements; no source will be copied.
policy.ordinaryDependencies: Published third-party packages may be selected independently under their own licenses. Lockfile, license and notice review is required before submission.
prohibited: Copying candidate application source, schemas, prompts, UI text, assets or tests
Opening or transferring .env files, credentials, keystores, databases, build output or dependency directories
Using quarantined retail, employer, client, MyTeams or Pushhpa roots
Treating untracked or locally modified files as cleared source

cleanRoom.destinationIntent: Rebuild bounded project, repository-state, evidence, deterministic readiness, report, advisory-import and history behaviors from IntelliLoop contracts.
cleanRoom.separation: Develop from R1/R2 requirements and test fixtures. Do not copy identifiers, prose, schemas, file structure, algorithms or UI composition.

cleanRoom.destinationIntent: Create IntelliLoop-specific Active Twin, deterministic Reconcile Core, bounded TypeScript code mapper, citation validator, Passport and retail demo fixtures from the frozen product model.
cleanRoom.separation: Greenfield implementation owned by IntelliLoop; candidate code is not an implementation template.

contractReference.allowedUse: Inform bounded project registry and manifest/config discovery acceptance criteria only.
Inform import idempotency, provenance, audit timeline, context packaging and export acceptance criteria only.
contractReference.specialConcern: Candidate has 667 untracked files and no commit baseline; no file is provenance-cleared.

contractReference.allowedUse: Inform graph, observation import, policy separation, dry-run and temporal-lineage acceptance criteria only.
contractReference.specialConcern: Recorded baseline includes 210 tracked modifications and 12 untracked paths; the broader executor/governance domain is intentionally excluded.

contractReference.allowedUse: Inform trust-state and provenance-screen usability criteria only.
Inform competition-story hierarchy and trust visualization acceptance criteria only.

excluded.scope: All remaining candidate capabilities at or below 50 percent maturity
excluded.reason: Insufficient distinct, proven or portable value for the frozen build.

excluded.scope: Candidate execution, terminal, git-write, patch, commit, push and deployment behaviors
excluded.reason: Outside the competition core and incompatible with the read-only repository boundary.

excluded.scope: Live production twin, shadow traffic, continuous training, autonomous repair/deploy, agent orchestration, predictive scaling and multi-provider fabric

cleanRoomControls: Build only from this freeze, R1 contracts, public package documentation and independently authored fixtures.
Record a destination-file provenance header or ledger entry identifying greenfield authorship and requirement IDs.
Do not keep candidate source open while authoring equivalent modules; use behavioral acceptance criteria, not code transcription.
Use new names, schemas, structure, copy and visual composition tailored to the Active Software Twin.
Run a pre-submission similarity and secrets scan and retain the result.
Require a later written policy/ownership decision before changing directSourceCopyAuthorized.
